saudagar-premium-perfume-gift-set-5-x-20.name: Saudagar Premium Perfume Gift Set – 5 × 20 ml (100 ml)
saudagar-premium-perfume-gift-set-5-x-20.desc:
Discover the joy of fragrance with the Saudagar Premium Perfume Gift Set, featuring five distinctive fragrances in one elegant gift box. This exclusive collection brings together refreshing Green Musk, rich Oud, elegant fruity-floral White Code, mysterious Black Code and captivating Pink Bomb.

With three unisex fragrances and two specially selected women’s fragrances, this collection offers a scent for every mood and personality.

Beautifully presented in a premium gift box, it’s a thoughtful choice for birthdays, anniversaries, festivals and special celebrations.

What’s inside

  • Green Musk: unisex
  • Oud: unisex
  • White Code: unisex
  • Black Code: men’s fragrance
  • Pink Bomb: women’s fragrance

Product details

  • Brand: Saudagar Perfumers
  • Total quantity: 100 ml
  • Includes: 5 perfumes × 20 ml each
  • Packaging: premium gift box
saudagar-premium-perfume-gift-set-5-x-20.short: Five Saudagar perfumes of 20 ml each (Green Musk, Oud, White Code, Black Code and Pink Bomb) in one premium gift box.
saudagar-premium-perfume-gift-set-5-x-20.insp: A gift box that brings together five Saudagar signatures: three unisex fragrances and two chosen for her, so there is a scent for every mood.
saudagar-premium-perfume-gift-set-5-x-20.wear: Try a different bottle each day to find your favourite, or match the scent to the moment: Green Musk and White Code for daytime, Oud and Black Code for evenings, Pink Bomb for celebrations.

kasturi.name: Kasturi
kasturi.short: A traditional Indian musk: spicy herbs and saffron over kasturi musk, sandalwood and powdery amber.
kasturi.insp: Kasturi, the natural musk of Indian perfumery.
kasturi.wear: Apply to the wrists and behind the ears. Its powdery musk sits close to the skin, so it suits prayer, festivals and quiet evenings.

sabaya-by-al-rehab.name: Sabaya by Al-Rehab
sabaya-by-al-rehab.short: A bright floral-citrus with grapefruit, lemon and apple blossom over rose, jasmine and soft musk.
sabaya-by-al-rehab.wear: A cheerful everyday scent. Spray on the pulse points in the morning; it is at its best in spring and summer.

oud-sheikha.name: Oud Sheikha
oud-sheikha.short: A graceful, clean oud: lemon, saffron and rose over a soft floral heart and warm agarwood with white musk.
oud-sheikha.wear: A gentle oud for those new to oud. Wear it day or night; two sprays on the neck are enough.

the-moon.name: The Moon
the-moon.short: A rich berry-and-oud fragrance: raspberry, lychee and dark berries against Turkish rose, frankincense and leather.
the-moon.wear: Opulent and long lasting. Keep it for evenings and celebrations; one or two sprays on the chest and neck.

raksha-bandhan-special-fragrance-combo.name: Raksha Bandhan Special Fragrance Combo
raksha-bandhan-special-fragrance-combo.desc:
Celebrate the beautiful bond of love, memories and togetherness with our Raksha Bandhan Special Fragrance Combo.

Make this Raksha Bandhan even more special with a thoughtfully curated fragrance combo, beautifully presented as a perfect festive gift for your loved ones.

Special Raksha Bandhan offer: get 1 beautiful rakhi free with every combo.

This exclusive combo is available in limited stock only. Once the available stock is sold out, this special Raksha Bandhan offer may no longer be available.

Why you’ll love it

  • Premium Raksha Bandhan special fragrance combo
  • 1 rakhi free with every combo
  • Perfect for festive gifting
  • Beautiful and memorable presentation
  • Limited stock available

Celebrate the bond. Share the fragrance. Create beautiful memories.
raksha-bandhan-special-fragrance-combo.short: A festive fragrance combo made for gifting on Raksha Bandhan, with one rakhi free with every combo.
raksha-bandhan-special-fragrance-combo.insp: Made to celebrate the bond between brothers and sisters: a ready festive gift of Saudagar fragrances.
raksha-bandhan-special-fragrance-combo.wear: Give it as a festive gift. Each perfume is worn on the pulse points; let the receiver pick a scent for each occasion.

gucci-flora.name: Gucci Flora
gucci-flora.short: A sophisticated floral: mandarin and pear over peony, rose and osmanthus, settling on musk, patchouli and leather.
gucci-flora.wear: Elegant for daytime, the office and formal occasions. Spray on the wrists and neck.

bin-shaikh.name: Bin Shaikh
bin-shaikh.desc: Bin Shaikh is a rich oriental fragrance for men and women. Saffron, rose and lavender open over citrus and oakmoss, a sweet heart of sugar, bakhoor, jasmine and orchid follows, and it settles on agarwood, amber, patchouli and white musk.
bin-shaikh.short: A rich oriental: saffron and rose over sugar, bakhoor and jasmine, ending in agarwood, amber and white musk.
bin-shaikh.insp: Bin Shaikh by Ahmed Al Maghribi.
bin-shaikh.wear: A warm, sweet oud for evenings and festivals. Two sprays on the neck and chest; it lasts well into the night.

bdc.name: BDC
bdc.desc: BDC is a woody aromatic fragrance for men. Lemon zest, bergamot and mint open with a clean sparkle, lavender, pineapple and geranium form the heart, and sandalwood, cedar and tonka bean give it a smooth, refined finish.
bdc.short: A woody aromatic for men: lemon, bergamot and mint over lavender, finishing on sandalwood, cedar and tonka.
bdc.insp: Bleu de Chanel Parfum by Chanel.
bdc.wear: A versatile signature for the office, dinners and everyday wear. Spray on the neck and chest.

wanted.name: Wanted
wanted.desc: Wanted is a woody spicy fragrance for men. Lemon, ginger and lavender give a lively start, apple, cardamom and juniper warm the heart, and tonka bean, amber wood and vetiver leave a confident trail.
wanted.short: A woody spicy for men: lemon, ginger and lavender, warmed by cardamom and apple, on tonka and vetiver.
wanted.wear: Bold and warm. Wear it for evenings out and dates; two sprays are enough.

shanaya-amber.name: Shanaya Amber
shanaya-amber.desc: Shanaya Amber is an oriental woody fragrance for men and women. Saffron, rose and pimento open warmly, a soft heart of florals, patchouli and caramel follows, and it rests on agarwood, incense, resins, amber and musk.
shanaya-amber.short: An oriental woody: saffron, rose and pimento over caramel and patchouli, resting on agarwood, incense and amber.
shanaya-amber.wear: Warm and sweet. Wear it in the evening and in cooler months; apply to the neck and wrists.

sauvage.name: Sauvage
sauvage.short: A fiercely fresh fougère: Calabrian bergamot and pepper over lavender and vetiver, on ambroxan, cedar and labdanum.
sauvage.wear: A crowd-pleaser for any occasion, season or time of day. Two to three sprays on the neck and chest.

rebel.name: 9PM Rebel
rebel.short: A playful aromatic-fruity: pineapple, green apple and mandarin over oakmoss and vanilla, with burnt caramel and musk.
rebel.wear: Built for nightlife, parties and casual outings. Spray on the neck and chest before you head out.

purple-oud.name: Purple Oud
purple-oud.short: A radiant modern oud: juicy orange, pink pepper and saffron meet rich agarwood and warm spices.
purple-oud.wear: A fresh take on oud that works day and night in every season. Two sprays on the neck.

oud.name: Oud Al Wahid
oud.short: A majestic traditional oud: smoky spices and resins, a deep agarwood heart, and dark amber with velvety musk.
oud.wear: Bold and dignified. Keep it for formal occasions, evenings and cold weather; one or two sprays are enough.

marj.name: Marj
marj.short: An opulent oriental: honeyed oud and spices, a layered saffron-floral heart, and leather, amber and sandalwood.
marj.wear: Rich and complex. For grand celebrations, weddings and cold evenings; one or two sprays.

mafia-oud.name: Mafia Oud
mafia-oud.short: A bold masculine oud: smoky oud, oakmoss and patchouli, brightened by pineapple and rose, on vanilla and sandalwood.
mafia-oud.wear: Powerful and commanding. For evenings and nights out; two sprays on the neck.

leather.name: Leather
leather.short: A refined oriental leather: rich leather and suede with jasmine and smoky frankincense.
leather.wear: Warm and commanding. For formal occasions, evening outings and cold weather.

khamarah.name: Khamarah
khamarah.short: A decadent spicy gourmand: cinnamon and nutmeg, dates and praline, on vanilla, tonka and amber.
khamarah.wear: Cozy and enchanting. Perfect for evenings, special occasions and cold weather.

imagination.name: Imagination Wow
imagination.short: A luminous citrus-aromatic: citron, bergamot and orange, neroli and ginger, on black tea, guaiac wood and olibanum.
imagination.wear: Clean and refined. A signature for sunny days, the office and polished everyday wear.

fabhir.name: Fakhir
fabhir.short: A woody gourmand: bergamot, roasted chestnut and powdery iris over dark woods, amber and aged whisky.
fabhir.insp: Al Fakhir by Athoor Al Alam.
fabhir.wear: Rich and memorable. For formal evenings, cooler weather and special events.

erba-pura-2.name: Erba Pura
erba-pura-2.desc: Erba Pura is a radiant fruity oriental for men and women. Sicilian orange, Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian lemon burst open into a juicy heart of fruits, then settle on white musk, Madagascar vanilla and amber.
erba-pura-2.short: A radiant fruity oriental: Sicilian citrus and juicy fruits over white musk, vanilla and amber.
erba-pura-2.wear: Loud and joyful. Two sprays are enough for a whole day; great for daytime outings and parties.

cr7.name: CR7
cr7.short: An energetic aromatic fougère: lavender, cardamom and bergamot over tobacco and cinnamon, on vanilla and amber.
cr7.wear: For active days, casual outings and evenings. Spray on the neck and chest.

chocolate-musk.name: Chocolate Musk
chocolate-musk.short: A sweet, cozy gourmand: rich chocolate and creamy vanilla wrapped in soft white musk.
chocolate-musk.insp: The comfort of chocolate desserts, softened with clean musk.
chocolate-musk.wear: Cozy and inviting. Ideal for cold weather and relaxed evenings; apply to the wrists and neck.

br540.name: BR540
br540.short: A luminous amber floral: saffron and jasmine over amber wood and ambergris, on fir resin and cedar.
br540.insp: Baccarat Rouge 540 by Maison Francis Kurkdjian.
br540.wear: Magnetic and long lasting. A stunning signature for formal events, evenings and special occasions.

havana-ice.name: Hawas Ice
havana-ice.short: An icy aquatic-fruity: frozen apple, lemon and mint, a sweet plum heart, on amber, driftwood and musk.
havana-ice.wear: Excels in hot weather, active days and parties. Spray generously on the neck and chest.

ultra-male.name: Ultra Male
ultra-male.desc: A seductive and powerful masculine fragrance inspired by Jean Paul Gaultier’s legendary Ultra Male, Ultra Male is crafted for the confident man who loves to stand out with an intense, captivating aura.
ultra-male.short: A seductive oriental fougère: pear, lavender and mint over cinnamon and sage, on black vanilla and amber.
ultra-male.insp: Ultra Male by Jean Paul Gaultier.
ultra-male.wear: Famous for projection. The ultimate choice for nightlife, parties and evening dates.

althair.name: Althair
althair.short: An elegant oriental vanilla: cinnamon, orange blossom and cardamom over bourbon vanilla, on praline and tonka.
althair.wear: Luxurious and warm. For evenings, cold weather and special events.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.short: A hypnotic floral-woody: hazelnut, pear and frankincense, osmanthus and rose, on sandalwood, vanilla and ambergris.
guidance.wear: Exceptional projection. For high-end occasions, signature evening wear and cold weather.

silver-mountain-water.name: Silver Mountain Water
silver-mountain-water.short: A crisp alpine freshness: bergamot and mandarin, green tea and blackcurrant, on musk, petitgrain and sandalwood.
silver-mountain-water.wear: For warm weather, daytime, the office and everyday casual wear.

alluri.name: Allure
alluri.desc: A dynamic and sensual masculine fragrance inspired by Chanel’s iconic Allure Homme Sport Eau Extrême, Allure is designed for the modern man who thrives on intensity, passion, and effortless charm.
alluri.short: A fresh spicy woody: mandarin, mint and cypress over black pepper, on tonka, white musk and sandalwood.
alluri.insp: Allure Homme Sport Eau Extrême by Chanel.
alluri.wear: Highly versatile: daily wear, the gym, casual outings or evening dates.

qahwa.name: Qahwa
qahwa.desc: Qahwa is a warm Arabian coffee fragrance. Roasted coffee and cardamom open like a freshly poured cup of qahwa, saffron and a touch of rose warm the heart, and it settles on soft oud, amber and vanilla.
qahwa.short: A warm Arabian coffee scent: roasted coffee and cardamom, saffron and rose, on soft oud, amber and vanilla.
qahwa.insp: Qahwa, the cardamom-spiced Arabic coffee served as a welcome.
qahwa.wear: Cozy and inviting. Wear it in the evening and in cooler months; two sprays on the neck.

oud-wood.name: Oud Wood
oud-wood.short: A rare woody oriental: oud and rosewood with cardamom and Sichuan pepper, on sandalwood, vanilla and amber.
oud-wood.wear: Distinctive and elegant. For evenings, formal occasions and cooler weather.
